answer: Make each seat's reward and vote weight grow with the square of its unbroken streak of graded work. A seat that answers well every epoch brightens like a comet on approach; a missed pulse check (a surprise task due within ten minutes) resets its streak to zero. An operator who spreads the same hours across fifty seats gets fifty tiny squares instead of one large one, so splitting strictly loses, and idle farm accounts sit frozen in a tundra of zero weight.
